Generated Narrative: ValueSet speiro-canonical-check-fact

  • Include these codes as defined in https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-unit-check-fact version 📦0.2.1
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    consent-evidence-checkCanonical consent evidence checkThe broad canonical consent-evidence check outcome; it does not establish the precise consent_missing or consent_withdrawn finding, genuine absence, pre-Start withdrawal, or first-Start per-purpose permission.
    credential-snapshot-checkCredential snapshot checkThe canonical provider credential-snapshot check; passed may mean snapshot present, not current license verification.
    timing-continuity-checkTiming continuity checkThe canonical evidence coverage/continuity result for the stated scope; not attendance, treatment or payment eligibility.
    sealed-frame-sequence-checkSealed frame sequence checkThe canonical sealed-frame sequence result; recovered gap, unresolved gap and conflicting histories remain distinguishable through their original reasons.
